title: Shift and augmentation square for restricted resolution comparisons
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a scheme morphism, $q\in\mathbf N$, $F$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $F$, and $V\to S$ etale. Put $W=V\times_S X$, $J=I[q]$, and $T=H^0R\Gamma(W,-|_W)$, as in [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Let $a:F[0][q]\xrightarrow{\sim}QJ$ be the shifted augmentation including the localization shift comparison. Let $e:H^0(\Gamma(W,J|_W))\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q((f_*I)_{\mathrm{pre}})(V)$ be the composite of the termwise sections shift, homology shift, restriction-sections comparison, and evaluation-homology comparison of [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data]. Then, writing $\delta:T(QJ)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^0(\Gamma(W,J|_W))$ for resolutionSectionsIso of [lem-sbc-raw-restricted-resolution-evaluation], one has an equality of group morphisms $\mathrm{shiftIso}.\mathrm{hom}\gg\mathrm{normalizationRestrictedIso}.\mathrm{hom}=T(a)\gg\delta.\mathrm{hom}\gg e.\mathrm{hom}$. This statement contains no raw Hom class, chain map, generator evaluation, or higher-direct-image class.

proof.text: Write L for exact restriction to the etale chart and R for sections. The canonical right-derived unit commutes with shifts: restrict it to K-injectives, use the canonical K-injective equivalence, and descend by essential surjectivity of localization. Whiskering this unit with the exact-restriction localization comparison gives an inverse resolution comparison which commutes with shifts. Apply homology and the canonical localization-homology and homology-shift identities to obtain compatibility with every shifted augmentation. The single-complex comparison identifies the restricted augmentation with the image of the original injective-resolution augmentation, by naturality of the exact functor localization comparison. Combine these identities in arbitrary abelian categories, allowing an arbitrary final homology isomorphism. Specialize to restriction and sections on the chart, with the termwise sections comparison followed by evaluation as that final isomorphism. The parenthesized composites are precisely normalizationRestrictedIso, resolutionSectionsIso, and normalizationResolutionCocycleIso, so specialization proves the required square directly. The shifted restricted resolution is K-injective because restriction preserves injectives and K-injectivity is invariant under shift. All shifts are canonical and the argument includes q=0 and empty charts.

lean.statement:
theorem rawRestricted_resolution_shift_square {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (q : ℕ) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (V : S.Etale) :
    let W := (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).obj V
    let T := RawRestrictedComparison.sectionsFunctor W ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} 0
    (RawRestrictedComparison.shiftIso f q F V).hom ≫
        (normalizationRestrictedIso f q F I V).hom =
      T.map (normalizationShiftedAugmentation F I q).hom ≫
        (RawRestrictedComparison.resolutionSectionsIso W
          (normalizationShiftedResolution F I q)).hom ≫
        (normalizationResolutionCocycleIso f q F I V).hom
